title: How we make money, and a privacy policy
body: Two new pages explain who pays DoNotKYC (affiliate links and labelled sponsored tiles, with our advertising rules) and confirm the site collects no data about visitors.

title: Boltz under review: swaps suspended
body: Boltz suspended its swaps on 3 August 2026 and its website no longer resolves. The listing stays visible with a warning and is out of our recommendations until the service is back.

title: Synapse under review
body: synapseprotocol.com now redirects to hypercall.xyz/synapse. We are confirming the service and its address before updating the listing.

title: 1inch moved to 1inch.com
body: The listing now points to the new domain.

title: Weekly automatic check of every listing
body: Every Monday a script checks that each platform's site still answers and has not moved to another domain, and lists platforms whose last real-money test is older than 90 days.

title: Side-by-side comparisons
body: 18 comparisons of platforms that do the same job, such as MEXC vs Bybit or Bisq vs Hodl Hodl.

title: Site available in 9 languages
body: English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Turkish and Chinese.

title: New directory, one page per platform
body: Platforms are now sorted by how much identity they ask for (None, Light, Tiered), with a page each, topic pages and alternatives to exchanges that require ID. Data errors fixed for KCEX, DeGate and Boltz. Google Analytics and third-party logos removed: the site makes no request to any other service.
